examples.en: "Gratification" and "gratitude" have the same etymological root.
The lords and doctors manifested their gratification also.
examples.zh: 勋爵和医生们也表达了他们的喜悦。

examples.en: A feed will usually provide instant gratification to a crying baby.
examples.zh: 喂食通常可使正在哭闹的婴儿立即得到满足。

synonyms.meaning: 满意；喜悦；使人满意之事
